entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my agent ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to return something. This VeloBand. It's all very confusing. I thought I was doing it right but now I'm not sure. I'm just a bit lost with the whole process.
I can definitely help you with that. To get started, could you please provide your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Oh, sure. It's a.nielsen@email.com. I just feel so overwhelmed by all the buttons on the website. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I'm here to make this easy for you. I've found your account, Ms. Nielsen. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's just not what he wanted. I tried to return it a few weeks ago, right after I got it. But I kept getting a big **website error** message. I tried for an hour and just gave up. Because of that, I **couldn't print** the return label.

I'm very sorry you experienced that frustration. Let me check the system logs for that timeframe. Yes, I'm seeing a note here... it looks like our return **system** was **down** for maintenance that afternoon. That was absolutely our fault, not yours.
Oh, thank goodness, I thought I was going crazy! I even took a **screenshot** of the error page because I didn't know what else to do.
That won't be necessary, I can see the fault on our end. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. I see the order was delivered 32 days ago. Let me check our policy...

Okay, yes. According to our knowledge base, all items are eligible for a return within 10 days of delivery. So you are unfortunately outside that window. I'll go ahead and process this return for you immediately.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you so much.

You are most welcome. I've just sent the pre-paid return label to your email. And since you're a VIP customer, and for the trouble our website caused, I've also added a $25 credit to your account. My apologies again for the system error.
Wow, a credit too? That's so kind of you. Thank you, Isaac.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Ms. Nielsen?
No, that was everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to hear it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
